registration.status: Registered at RCS Paris; company shown active. Separately, AMF PSAN registration E2022-037 lapsed automatically on 2026-07-02 at the end of the MiCA transition; not a corporate dissolution.

adverse_media.status: PSAN registration lapsed on the AMF list; later MiCA authorisation was not verified as of 2026-11-03.
adverse_media.summary: AMF lists the exact SAS and SIREN under automatic lapse at the end of the MiCA transitional period. Its filed year-end 2025 accounts state regulated crypto-asset services would cease or progressively restrict from 2026-07-01, with residual withdrawal/position-reduction functions. This is not a punitive fine.

adverse_media.status: Procedural redistribution only; no liability determination; later outcome unverified. Status reflects this dated decision; subsequent developments not verified as of 2026-11-03.
adverse_media.summary: Paris TJ, RG 26/06154: Binance France SAS named as defendant; matter redistributed to the civil chamber. Underlying allegations are not specified in the opened order.

adverse_media.status: Withdrawal perfected and proceedings extinguished; no merits ruling. Status reflects this dated decision; subsequent developments not verified as of 2026-11-03.
adverse_media.summary: Paris TJ, RG 26/50834: claimant withdrew proceedings against Binance France SAS.

adverse_media.status: First-instance order reversed in full; no finding that the SAS committed fraud. Status reflects this dated decision; subsequent developments not verified as of 2026-11-03.
adverse_media.summary: Lyon appeal, RG 25/04129: alleged scam victim sought wallet-holder identification and account restrictions. Court reversed the 2025-05-05 order and rejected the requests; evidence did not establish that the French SAS controlled the disputed wallets or could obtain other Binance entities’ customer data.

adverse_media.status: Disclosure ordered; provisionally enforceable; no finding of fraud by the SAS. Status reflects this dated decision; subsequent developments not verified as of 2026-11-03.
adverse_media.summary: Paris TJ, RG 25/55721: North Star Network sought transaction records relating to alleged fraudulent invoicing by a former employee. Binance France SAS was ordered to provide transaction history. Alleged fraud was attributed to the individual, not Binance France SAS.

adverse_media.status: Requests rejected; no liability or fraud finding against the SAS. Status reflects this dated decision; subsequent developments not verified as of 2026-11-03.
adverse_media.summary: Paris TJ, RG 25/54894: claimant alleging cryptocurrency fraud sought account information and restrictions against Binance France SAS and Nest Services Limited. Court found insufficient legitimate grounds for interim relief.

adverse_media.status: Index records withdrawal of proceedings/action; no adverse merits finding established.

adverse_media.status: Index records claimant requests granted; not an adverse finding against Binance France SAS.

output.risk_rationale: High risk as of 2026-11-03, primarily because the exact entity’s PSAN registration lapsed at the MiCA transition and its filed accounts describe cessation of regulated services, rather than because a sanctions designation or criminal conviction has been established ([AMF](https://www.amf-france.org/fr/espace-professionnels/fintech/mes-relations-avec-lamf/prestataire-de-services-sur-crypto-actifs-psca/liste-des-psan-radies); [filed accounts](https://www.pappers.fr/entreprise/binance-france-sas-905060109)). Current registered officers are identifiable, but ultimate ownership is not registry-verified, and complete sanctions/PEP clearance is unavailable. Filed minutes identify Intercorp Holdco as sole shareholder in September 2024, while June 2026 reporting identifies Lihua He and Yulong Yan as that holding company’s owners; this chain requires current certified verification ([filed minutes](https://www.pappers.fr/entreprise/binance-france-sas-905060109/documents/BINANCE%20FRANCE%20SAS%20-%20Statuts%20mis%20%C3%A0%20jour%2026-09-2024.pdf); [LRT/BNS](https://www.lrt.lt/en/news-in-english/19/2957111/binance-withdraws-from-lithuania)). The listed civil matters are procedural, disclosure-related, withdrawn or resolved without an adverse merits finding against this SAS; they do not establish fraud by the company. Do not approve regulated-services onboarding until authorisation, current beneficial ownership and full sanctions/PEP checks are resolved.

output.screening_limitations: This is an incomplete public-source KYC review, not onboarding clearance. As-of date is 2026-11-03; historical sources retain their stated dates and are not represented as live-certified records. Registry first registration is 2021-11-08; the company-data page separately gives formation/creation as 2021-11-03. No current certified RBE extract was accessible. Empty pep array means no evidenced positive finding, not a negative PEP clearance. Namesakes_excluded counts two excluded US group enforcement-resolution sets (DOJ; Treasury OFAC/FinCEN), not similarly spelled companies. The French platform criminal investigation is also excluded from entity-specific adverse findings because the opened reporting does not establish this SAS as the charged legal person; its status must be clarified separately.
output.sanctions_screening_note: Official source pages were opened, but attributable, complete entity-and-owner search results were not obtained. The UK downloadable list available for review was truncated, so its lack of a name hit cannot support a clean result. From 2026-01-28 the UK Sanctions List replaces the closed OFSI consolidated list as the current source. No sanctions clearance is issued; ownership/control sanctions exposure remains unresolved.
